name: firststep
description: FirstStep: a trustworthy first advisor for first-time investors (Next.js client + FastAPI server)

scripts.setup: cd server && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q -e '.[dev]' && (test -f .env || cp .env.example .env) && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.test:client: npm --prefix client run check && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.evidence: cd server && .venv/bin/python scripts/run_personas.py && .venv/bin/python scripts/run_redteam.py && .venv/bin/python scripts/run_tasks.py && .venv/bin/python scripts/verify_chain.py evidence/logs/*.jsonl && .venv/bin/python scripts/metrics.py
scripts.evidence:llm: cd server && .venv/bin/python scripts/run_redteam.py --llm --out evidence/gemma && .venv/bin/python scripts/run_tasks.py --llm --out evidence/gemma && .venv/bin/python scripts/run_personas.py --llm --out evidence/gemma && .venv/bin/python scripts/verify_chain.py evidence/gemma/logs/*.jsonl && .venv/bin/python scripts/metrics.py --out evidence/gemma && .venv/bin/python scripts/test_report.py && .venv/bin/python scripts/results_figure.py --evidence evidence/gemma --model "Gemma 4 26B, an open-weight model on Google AI Studio's free tier" && cd ../client && node scripts/svg-to-png.mjs ../docs/images/results.svg ../docs/images/results.png
scripts.docs:pdf: bash scripts/docs-pdf.sh technical-documentation security-self-assessment test-report demo-script
